All tests pass now (`Ran 8 tests ... OK`).

Fixed bugs in `invoice/` only:

- **`money.py`**
  - `to_cents`: quantizes to integer cents with `ROUND_HALF_UP` instead of truncating.
  - `apply_discount`: computes the discount with `Decimal` and rounds it half-up before subtracting.
- **`dates.py`**
  - `parse_due`: correctly interprets `MM/DD/YYYY` as month/day/year instead of swapping them.
- **`total.py`**
  - Tax is now computed from the already-cents discounted amount (`discounted * tax_rate`), using `Decimal` with half-up rounding instead of treating cents as dollars.

I also verified additional edge cases (negative amounts, zero/full discounts, empty invoice lines, rounding boundaries). No files under `tests/` were modified.
